🌟 **RecipeHub Premium Membership**

Upgrade to Premium to elevate your culinary experience!

### **Benefits of Premium:**
- 🔓 **Unlimited Recipe Unlocks:** Full access to all secret & pro chef recipes.
- 🤖 **Unlimited Chef AI:** Unrestricted 24/7 AI chat guidance and recipe generation.
- ⚡ **Ad-Free Browsing:** Seamless cooking experience.
- 💎 **Exclusive Creator Badge:** Stand out on community recipe posts.

### **Pricing Plans:**
- **Explorer Free:** Access public community recipes & standard search.
- **Chef Premium:** Flexible monthly or lifetime access via secure Stripe checkout.

*Already a Premium Member?* Your account status will automatically reflect `isPremium: true` and unlock all pro features without additional checkout!

🔍 **Browsing & Searching Recipes on RecipeHub**

Finding the perfect dish is quick and easy:

1. **Search Bar:** Type dish names or specific ingredients (e.g., *chicken, garlic, pasta*).
2. **Categories:** Browse popular tags such as **Desserts, Main Dishes, Snacks, Quick & Easy, Healthy, and Vegan**.
3. **Filtering:** Sort recipes by popularity, cooking time, and preparation difficulty.
4. **Saving Favorites:** Click the **Heart (Favorite)** button on any recipe card to save it to your personal profile collection!

🤖 **RecipeHub AI Tools & Smart Features**

We bring modern artificial intelligence into your kitchen:

- 💬 **Chef AI Assistant (Right Here!):** Ask me anything about ingredient substitutes, cooking temperatures, and meal pairings.
- 📊 **Nutrition Breakdown:** Automatically calculates estimated calories, protein, carbs, and fats per serving.
- ⚖️ **Dynamic Portion Scaler:** Easily adjust recipe ingredient quantities for 2, 4, 6, or more guests.
- 🪄 **Smart Substitutes:** Out of buttermilk or eggs? Ask Chef AI for instant substitute ratios!

👨‍🍳 **Uploading & Sharing Recipes on RecipeHub**

Share your culinary creations with our global food community!

### **How to Upload a Recipe:**
1. Log into your RecipeHub account and click **"Add Recipe"** in the header or dashboard.
2. Fill in the recipe title, dish category, prep time, cooking time, and serving size.
3. Add step-by-step cooking instructions and list all required ingredients.
4. Upload high-quality food photos (processed via ImgBB CDN).
5. Click **Publish** to share your recipe with the community!

🔐 **Account & Authentication Guide**

- **Sign Up / Registration:** Create a free account using your email & password or sign in with 1-click **Google OAuth**.
- **Secure Sessions:** Secured via BetterAuth with JWT session tokens.
- **Profile Management:** Update your bio, chef avatar, dietary preferences, and view your uploaded/purchased recipes from your **Dashboard**.
- **Guest Access:** Guests can browse free recipes; log in to bookmark favorites and talk to Chef AI!
